name: Alexandrina Katherine Montgomery Reyes
offenseFacts: On February 18, 2013, in Springfield, I took store merchandise without paying and was arrested. I pleaded guilty to Class 4 felony theft on July 15, 2013. I received twenty-four months of probation, completed the sentence on July 15, 2015, and paid the restitution ordered by the court. No other conviction is part of this application. I acknowledge my responsibility for the conduct and provide this complete statement in my own words for the diagnostic fixture.
personalHistory: I was born on November 23, 1988 in Springfield, Illinois. I completed high school in 2006 and a shipping and logistics certificate in 2018. I lived in Springfield from birth through 2010, worked in retail, and returned in 2012 after two years in Peoria working in food service. I have worked in warehouse shipping in Springfield since 2016. I am unmarried and have no children or child-support obligation. I completed financial counseling in 2017 and have no substance-abuse or mental-health treatment history to report. I volunteer at a food pantry and neighborhood cleanup events. My employers recognized my attendance in 2019 and 2023. Supporting records and recommendation letters must be obtained by the participant; this diagnostic narrative does not create them. I served in the United States Army from 2017 to 2021, completed a tour of duty and received an honorable discharge on September 30, 2021. My DD-214 and tour documentation must accompany the application.
reasons: I seek a certificate because my conviction has limited my work and housing opportunities. I was denied an apartment application and a supervisory job after background checks. I ask the Board to consider completion of my sentence, stable employment, counseling and community service. I understand relief is discretionary. I want an opportunity to move forward while remaining truthful about my history.
